fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has recently released the official notification for the post of Computer Instructor on the official website of RSSB. This recruitment has been issued for 3951 posts. Online applying process for RSSB Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026 has started from 25 May 2026 and candidate can apply untill 23 June 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for RSSB Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB)

RSSB Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026

RSSB Advt No. : 07/2026

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 22 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 25 May 2026
  • Last Date : 23 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 26 June 2026
  • Exam Date (Senior Instructor) : 22 August 2026
  • Exam Date (Basic Instructor) : 23 August 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer), EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

RSSB Computer Instructor Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 January 2027
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per RSSB Computer Instructor Recruitment Rules.

Total Posts : 3951 Posts

Post Name No. of Post
Computer Instructor 3951

RSSB Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Qualification
Senior Computer Instructor
  • Candidates must have an M.E./M.Tech degree in Computer Science, IT, ECE, EE, EEE, ETE, or EIE; or an M.Sc. in Computer Science/IT; or MCA/’B’ Level/’C’ Level qualification, or any equivalent/higher qualification recognized by the Government. Candidates should also have working knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture.
Basic Computer Instructor
  • Candidates must be a graduate with ‘A’ Level or PGDCA (minimum 1 year), or hold a B.E./B.Tech degree in Computer Science, IT, ECE, EE, EEE, EIC, or TIE, or a B.Sc. in Computer Science/IT, or a BCA from a recognized university. Any equivalent or higher qualification recognized by the Government is also acceptable. Candidates should also have working knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture.

RSSB Computer Instructor Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the RSSB before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for RSSB Computer Instructor recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।
